I fixed the type error in `src/index.ts`. `label` is declared as a `string` but was assigned the number `8417`, so I changed the value to the string `"8417"`.

`node_modules` didn't exist, so I ran `npm install --no-save typescript` to get a compiler. After that, `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit` passed with no errors.

I chose to change the value rather than the type. If `label` should really be a number, change the annotation to `number` and revert the value instead.
